annotations.title: Request a charter quote or empty leg booking

description: Send the traveller's trip and contact details to the Altivo Jets desk, for a full charter or a specific empty leg (empty_leg_ref). A specialist contacts the traveller by email or phone to confirm aircraft, availability and the all-in price, and names the operator on the quote. No payment is taken and nothing is booked or held by this call. Use only when the traveller asks Altivo to contact them, and confirm their name and email first.

destination.description: Arrival city or airport, e.g. "Mumbai", "BOM", "VABB", "Teterboro" or "KTEB".

email.description: Traveller's email; the desk replies here.

empty_leg_ref.description: Optional: the empty leg reference the traveller wants.

notes.description: Optional notes: luggage, pets, catering, timing.

origin.description: Departure city or airport, e.g. "Mumbai", "BOM", "VABB", "Teterboro" or "KTEB".

phone.description: Traveller's phone with country code (optional, speeds up the reply).

return_date.description: Return date for a round trip, YYYY-MM-DD.
